mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.phone, m.nickname, m.password, m.province, m.city, m.district, m.referrer_id, m.referrer_path, m.direct_seq, m.level, m.vip_expire_at, m.balance, m.frozen, m.green_points, m.status, m.token_version, m.last_login_at, m.remark, m.create_time, m.update_time from hys_member m
mapper.insert: insert into hys_member (phone, nickname, password, province, city, district, referrer_id, referrer_path, direct_seq, level, vip_expire_at, balance, frozen, green_points, status, token_version, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{phone}, #{nickname}, #{password}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{referrerId}, #{referrerPath}, #{directSeq}, #{level}, #{vipExpireAt}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{greenPoints}, #{status}, 0, #{remark}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update hys_member set last_login_at = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
update hys_member set token_version = token_version + 1, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
update hys_member set referrer_id = #{referrerId}, referrer_path = #{referrerPath}, direct_seq = #{directSeq}, token_version = token_version + 1, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
update hys_member set balance = balance + #{delta}, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId} and balance + #{delta} >= 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from hys_member where referrer_id = #{referrerId}
select count(1) from hys_member where referrer_path like concat(#{path}, '%') and member_id <> #{excludeId}
select count(1) from hys_member where referrer_path like concat(#{path}, '%') and member_id <> #{excludeId} and create_time >= #{since}

select m.member_id, m.phone, m.nickname, m.province, m.city, m.district, m.level, m.vip_expire_at, m.create_time, m.status, (select count(1) from hys_member c where c.referrer_id = m.member_id) as direct_count, (select count(1) from hys_member c where c.referrer_path like concat(m.referrer_path, m.member_id, ',%') and c.member_id <> m.member_id) as team_count from hys_member m where m.referrer_id = #{referrerId} order by m.member_id asc
select count(1) from hys_member where referrer_id is not null
select count(1) from hys_member where level = '1' and vip_expire_at > #{now}
select count(1) from hys_member where status = '2' or referrer_id is null
